workItem: Make the existing single PR Decision Evidence Reconciler capable of canonically bootstrapping non-canonical v1.8 bodies on pre-existing claimless PRs without weakening claim requirements for new Agent PR creation.
workItemDE: Den bestehenden Single-Writer PR Decision Evidence Reconciler so härten, dass nicht-kanonische v1.8-Bodies bestehender claimloser PRs kanonisch gebootstrapped werden können, ohne die Claim-Pflicht für neue Agenten-PRs zu lockern.
priorityReason: PR #1415 demonstrates a repeatable governance deadlock: structural v1.8 drift is correctly classified but the trusted renderer cannot materialize a bootstrap body because the historical PR has no added work-claim.
dependencies: existing single PR Decision Evidence Reconciler
boundaries: No second PR-body writer or template authority
PR_ALLOW_CLAIMLESS is allowed only in trusted-main reconciliation of an already-existing PR

rootCause.validatorFailure: PR #1415 muss technische Traceability in v1.8.0 standardmäßig einklappen.
rootCause.blocker: renderPullRequestBody.mjs defaults PR_ALLOW_CLAIMLESS=false, while the Decision Reconciler bootstrap render step did not override it for historical claimless PRs
rootCause.effect: bootstrap body generation fails before reconcilePrDecisionEvidence.mjs can patch the malformed v1.8 body

exitEvidence: Decision Reconciler bootstrap render step explicitly sets PR_ALLOW_CLAIMLESS=true.
Regression test proves the flag is scoped to the Decision Reconciler bootstrap block.
Merged stale writer claims #1378 and #1407 are released/non-exclusive.
No second PR-body writer, version authority or merge authority is introduced.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment.
releaseReason: Terminal coordination lease: PR #1428 was Human/CODEOWNER-merged as 16aa907dac52e7bd0f8cdd413f1b297f6bf84f91. Follow-up evidence proved that project/PVC metadata still had to be bound for historical claimless PR bootstrap; this historical claim must not remain the active writer.
